author: DeadAlienMX
body:
• IGN: Master_tito
  • Reason for getting banned: Excessive Infractions (Language)
  • I've been banned from this server since February 20, 2015. I have learned that acting like a child and swearing at random kids is unacceptable. I accepted my punishment and now I apologize for my immoral acts. Please give me one more opportunity to play and enjoy your amazing network you guys have created. Let me be part of your community.

    
       - Master_tito

title: Master_tito (Appealing an Infraction)

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

Although you've gained a huge 28 infractions, half dating back last year, I've decided to give you one last chance. If you even put a toenail out of line, believe me your chance of a second appeal will be most certainly unattainable, so I suggest you think twice before you talk in chat again here at Avicus.

Regards,
Blizzem_
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
